name: new_game_to_school_handoff
description: Normal New Game: name entry (family/given/nickname, player birthday and blood, Shiori birthday and blood, confirmations), the unskipped prologue with no input, then the fresh school handoff into mode 0x34 and 180 settled command-screen iterations. Same choices as newgame-golden-v1 set B.

provenance.source: .asset-cache/emu/newgame-golden-v1 set B (runs/nameB1, runs/nameB2, runs/setB inputs.jsonl and transitions.jsonl), PCSX-Redux tokimemo-emu sha256:3385342c, OpenBIOS
provenance.derivation: A press at vsync v of a run is first read by the iteration after the one observed at v (checked on every START: nameB1 v380 -> 1/2 at frame_count 6491, v490 -> 1/4 at 6600, v600 -> 1/6 at 6709; nameB2 v215 -> 1/8 at 7043, v255 -> 2/0 at 7083, v615 -> 2/2 at 7443; setB v20 -> 2/4 at 7597). Offsets are that visible frame_count minus the frame_count at which the segment predicate was first observed. Holds are copied in vsyncs; name entry runs one iteration per vsync except for two unlocated dropped vsyncs in nameB1.
provenance.uncertainty: family-name anchor is the first sample of the restored name-ready-v1 state, not the native onset of 1/1. Events between transitions in given-name and nickname may be one iteration early (one dropped vsync somewhere in v384..v491 and v494..v601). A slip that changes a transition fails expect_next; a press that lands but enters another kana, date or blood type (or a blank name that the game fills with a random preset) fails expect_state. The native start is the restored name-ready-v1 state; the port starts a fresh New Game, whose name pointer origin differs (port desktop centre, native left by the T-39004 chain), so the pointer moves are not proven to reach the same cells on both sides until a port run passes expect_state.
provenance.expect_state: set B values read from RAM 0x8014CC74..0x8014CCA7 (name_entry_family_name .. name_entry_shiori_blood) in runs/nameB1/v700.ram.bin and runs/nameB2/v700.ram.bin: each name one kana, CP932 82bf, padded with 8140, player month 1 day 2 blood 1 (2/3 B, player_birthday 0x432 at a1), Shiori month 0 day 0 blood 0 (1/1 A)

events.note: pointer to the chosen kana cell
confirm Shiori; the prologue starts about 100 iterations later

segments.note: no input: START would skip the prologue (prologue_mode_handler)
golden a6 is the anchor; a8 is the dispatch 180 iterations later

unsupported.reason: the installed port route observers stop at REI_TARGET_STAGE (at most 12); stages 12-21 are still being specified
no port observer reaches stage 21 and the 0x15 -> 0x34 handoff from the installed route yet
name-ready-v1 is a restored state already in 1/1; the native 1/1 onset iteration is not recorded, so name-entry frame_count phase is not comparable
